## Result

- Skill: delivery-review
- Review status: approved
- Package member: the registered primary plan at the single exact stored subject.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r5, unchanged approved/current four-member Design basis.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r2, bounded independent reassessment.
- Traceability result: complete prior sequencing/proof allocation remains adequate; TG-03 and MW-01 now explicitly allocate the example-only-change case.
- Material findings and correction targets: none.
- Recording status: targeted v2 review.record; fresh approval preserves the original delivery-review judgment and history.
- Open blockers: none for this Delivery scope.
- Next owner: Route; no activity change, work initialization or work mutation by this reviewer.
- Claim limits: no implementation, Code Review, final Verify, release or customer adoption claim.

## Reassessment and unchanged reliance basis

The before-text identity matches the exact plan approved by delivery-review. Independent line comparison establishes precisely two single-row replacements, TG-03 and MW-01; milestones, commands, dependencies, source allocations, other verification groups and final whole-change review/Verify checkpoint are unchanged. The reviewer retains the complete original plan and source assessment, freshly inspects its relied-on identities and judges the complete revised package with this bounded delta.

MW-01 now distinguishes an example-only revision from the separate parseable-but-invariant-breaking-pair case. It requires the affected example and owner in selection/handoff, the new exact example subject, and responsible-actor applicability/reassessment before treating prior approval as current. This directly operationalizes Design DES-SR-12/16 and its example contract/identity scenario. Unchanged parent text is correctly insufficient evidence for the changed relied-on example. The row explicitly limits mechanical selection to subjects and retains applicability judgment with responsible actors; it creates neither automatic CLI invalidation nor a new review gate.

TG-03 links that procedure under the existing M2 allocation. MW-01 retains its independent Code Review assessor, disposable installed-candidate environment, artifacts/counterexamples, durable evidence and expiry conditions. Thus the clarification is nonblocking refinement of already approved intent, not a new behavior, milestone or missing previously recorded finding. No finding is invented to describe it. The prior approval remains attached to its original identity and its conservatively stale applicability is not renewed; this current exact-subject judgment supplies new reliance.

## Verification and limits

Independently verified the before-text hash against the original stored plan subject and confirmed exactly two row replacements using Python hashlib/difflib. Fresh subject inspection confirms the Design r5 subjects remain unchanged. Author evidence records plan prose pass, plan-only readability pass with 75 warnings and diff check; these are inspectability evidence only. The prior complete Delivery assessment's source/command feasibility, test-maintenance and semantic/public-path proof reasoning remains applicable because those allocations and dependencies are unchanged.

No implementation or installation tests were run in this reassessment. Existing initialized pending work is read-only and unaffected. The 13 historical installer prose errors and all original findings/review history remain unchanged. Record-store validation and git diff --check are run after save; these checks do not supply implementation or final readiness.

## Independence provenance

Same concrete independent nonauthor reviewer task /root/independent_design_review. Primary-agent/plan authored the clarification following user direction; reviewer authored neither original plan nor correction. Reviewer independently compared the exact two-row delta with the prior complete-plan assessment and governing Design/Review policy, without model, work or route edits.
